hook: MI5 gave false evidence to protect a violent neo-Nazi spy known as Agent X.

sections.voiceover: MI5 gave false evidence to protect a violent neo-Nazi spy known as Agent X.
sections.visual_cue: Archival footage of London government headquarters with stark documentary framing

sections.voiceover: In September 2026, MI5 accepted that deceptive information was provided while defending Agent X. The Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office uncovered these actions across multiple legal proceedings. Where were those false claims submitted?
sections.visual_cue: Official government document pages turning with redaction highlights
b_roll: Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office report documents

sections.voiceover: Worse, the IPCO report found that one senior MI5 officer lied repeatedly.
sections.visual_cue: Close up on classified intelligence files stamped with security markings

sections.voiceover: The Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office revealed that evidence was given to 3 separate courts. Investigatory powers commissioner Lord Leveson stated that this conduct is as serious as anything he has ever dealt with.
sections.visual_cue: Portrait photograph of Lord Leveson with official inquiry backdrop
b_roll: Lord Leveson official inquiry press appearance

sections.voiceover: Lord Leveson condemned MI5 for misleading those three courts to protect Agent X.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of London courts exterior under overcast skies
